key_points: Survey: 70% say secondhand shopping important to household budgets, boosting eBay demand outlook.
Goldman Sachs broker for an eBay officer's proposed share sale, indicating potential insider selling.
GameStop raised its eBay stake to 6.5% while pursuing a $56B takeover bid.
Reports suggest Ryan Cohen may withdraw the GameStop takeover bid, lessening M&A premium prospects.
eBay said to review GameStop's longshot buyout offer this week.
